correctness.rationale: All-dimensional Walsh momentum–energy proof defines normalized states, counts the one-dimensional collision diagonal rank in every block and rules out cancellation across distinct momenta. The finite-dimensional dissipative argument establishes eventual decay on the bright complement for every strictly positive loss profile. The Krawtchouk dual-orthogonality identity and binomial quotient provide the exact localized capture law, with strict Hamming monotonicity and mean formula. The actual packaged modular observability and separate numerical projector verifiers replay correctly for dimensions one through four; finite checks are corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: An all-dimensional exact classification for a canonical hypercube two-boson collision detector, revealing exponentially many protected states, a sharply Hamming-distance-resolved capture law, strict separation monotonicity and a very small uniform-pair capture mean. This is a motivated physically interpretable many-configuration protection problem, not a random parameter slice, mere rename or known-table recomputation; it supplies an exact noninteracting baseline without claiming finite-time rates.
